integrity: An analytic causal-path argument establishes the infinite-volume formulas. Exhaustive finite-path rational checks independently corroborate the local calculation; they are not a substitute for its proof. Historical-priority conclusions remain best knowledge rather than independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only one irrevocable attempted deposition per nonseeded site, with i.i.d. uniform times and colors.
No multiple seeds, forced-site clock perturbations, nonuniform spatial rates, higher dimensions or repeated proposals.
Factorial asymptotics are for fixed nonzero bias and observation time; no uniform boundary-parameter limit.
scientific_scope: Single site preoccupied by either A or B at zero time in the infinite one-attempt nearest-neighbor antagonistic two-color adsorption process; all nondegenerate color biases, positive times at most one, and all positive integer site distances.
title: Exact factorial screening of a pinned color in antagonistic adsorption
